scope.heading_comment: Heading of the first settings group: which notes the plugin offers as link suggestions.

mode.name_comment: Setting name. Its dropdown chooses between the whole vault and a list of folders; the list is rendered directly below.
mode.vault_comment: Dropdown option: every note in the vault apart from the folders in the list below it. The trailing ellipsis points at that list — translate the meaning, not the English sentence structure. This exact label is also inserted into the warning text (largeVault).
mode.folders_comment: Dropdown option: only notes in the folders in the list below it. This exact label is also inserted into the warning text (largeVault), so it must read naturally inside quotation marks there.

scope.largeVault_comment: Warning shown under the dropdown, in the warning colour and after a warning icon, while the entire-vault option is selected. {{folders}} is replaced by the 'Selected folders' dropdown label and {{vault}} by the 'Entire vault, except…' label — keep both placeholders and the quotation marks around them.
scope.excludedHeading_comment: Heading of the folder list while 'Entire vault, except…' is selected: notes in these folders are not suggested.
scope.includedHeading_comment: Heading of the folder list while 'Selected folders' is selected: only notes in these folders are suggested.
scope.excludeFolder_comment: Tooltip of the + button (desktop) and label of the add row (mobile) that adds a folder to the excluded list.
scope.addFolder_comment: Tooltip of the + button (desktop) and label of the add row (mobile) that adds a folder to the list of selected folders.
scope.noFolders_comment: Shown in place of the list when 'Selected folders' is selected and no folder has been added, so the plugin suggests nothing.
scope.folderPlaceholder_comment: Placeholder inside an empty folder path field.
scope.includeSubfolders_comment: Label of the checkbox on each folder row. Ticked: notes in folders below this one count too. Unticked: only notes directly in this folder.
scope.removeFolder_comment: Tooltip of the button that removes a folder row from the list.
scope.folderNotFound_comment: Tooltip on the warning icon shown when a row's folder no longer exists in the vault — renamed, moved or deleted. The path is visible in the field beside it, so it is not repeated here.
scope.newFolder_comment: Name Obsidian's settings search uses for a folder row whose path field is still empty. Rarely seen.

trigger.heading_comment: Heading of the second settings group: the rules for when the suggestion list opens as the user types.

capitalOnly.name_comment: Toggle name. On: the list only opens for a word that starts with a capital letter or a digit.
capitalOnly.description_comment: Description of the 'Starts with a capital' toggle.

minCharacters.name_comment: Slider name: how much must be typed before the list opens.

maxWords.name_comment: Slider name: how many typed words, counting back from the cursor, can belong to one suggestion.

sections.heading_comment: Name of a row that opens a sub-page, and the title of that page: the parts of a note in which the suggestion list is allowed to open.
sections.text_comment: A part of a note: ordinary text. Always on. Also the first item of the summary line on the main page.
sections.codeBlocks_comment: A part of a note: fenced code blocks.
sections.inlineCode_comment: A part of a note: code between backticks inside a line.
sections.mathBlocks_comment: A part of a note: math blocks between $$ lines.
sections.inlineMath_comment: A part of a note: math between $ signs inside a line.
sections.comments_comment: A part of a note: Obsidian comments between %% markers.
sections.frontmatter_comment: A part of a note: the YAML properties block at the top. Use the word your language's Obsidian uses for it.

rows.heading_comment: Heading of the third settings group: what the suggestion list shows.

extraAliases.name_comment: Dropdown name. When a note matches, its other aliases can be listed as additional rows; this limits how many.
extraAliases.description_comment: Description of the 'Extra aliases per note' dropdown.
extraAliases.none_comment: Dropdown option: offer no extra aliases.
extraAliases.all_comment: Dropdown option after '1' and '2': three extra aliases or however many more the note has — in effect, all of them.
